"Depillo, Raymond V." <Raymond.Depillo@pseg.com> writes to the NYISO_TECH_EXCHANGE Discussion List: Certainly the problem Don identified is legitimate and can still occur. However, with the implementation of the ECAs we have seen a change in bidding behavior at the interfaces - HAMs no longer bid at or near the caps. Thus, by changing HAM prices of accepted DAM transactions to something like +/- $500, you can be reasonably sure your transaction will flow.
